visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in an outdoor park setting with a wide shot of a sandy path. A man enters from the left, wearing a black tweed jacket, blue jeans, and a unique black flap hat with ear flaps. In the background, a large white marble statue stands centered between two rows of trees with thinning autumn foliage. Decorative flower beds with yellow and white blossoms are visible in the foreground. Bright, flat, overcast lighting fills the scene. Yellow stylized text 'a minute with CHANEL' is overlaid. (2) The camera transitions to a medium close-up of the man talking. He has a warm expression and uses expressive hand gestures while holding a smartphone. The background shows a long, tree-lined alleyway in the park, with several green chairs scattered around. Small figures of people can be seen in the far distance. Traditional Chinese and English subtitles appear as white text at the bottom center. (3) Scene cuts to a dark, expansive indoor venue with a reflective, water-like floor. Large, glowing spheres representing planets and celestial bodies float in the air. A model in a long, colorful floral dress walks across the space and hugs another individual. The lighting is dramatic, with spotlights focused on the central action. (4) A montage sequence begins, alternating between close-ups of models on the runway and the man in the park. The runway shots feature diverse models in high-fashion garments. Some shots of the man use a vintage film-strip border effect, showing him sitting on a park bench. (5) Historical black and white footage of Gabrielle Chanel is displayed in a collage format, mixed with modern-day runway clips. The layout includes overlapping photos and film snippets, creating a layered, archival aesthetic. (6) Detailed product shots highlight specific items: a silver metallic quilted handbag, several white and pink button-down shirts displayed on mannequins, and various styles of shoes with red and black accents. The camera uses close-ups to show the textures and branding, including the 'Chanel' logo on shirt pockets. (7) The man is seen leaning against a statue in the park, wearing a Chanel-branded belt. He continues to address the camera directly. The video concludes with a wide shot of models walking in unison through the planetary set, followed by the man waving goodbye in the park environment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A clear, male voice provides a friendly narration in Mandarin. The voice is well-projected with moderate pitch and a professional tone. Underneath, a mid-tempo electronic background music track plays, featuring a simple synth melody and a steady electronic beat. A faint ambient floor of an outdoor environment is audible. (2) A sharp, percussive 'camera shutter' sound effect marks a transition. The music maintains its tempo but introduces a more prominent kick drum. The narrator continues speaking, his delivery pace remains steady and enunciated. (3) A 'whoosh' transition sound occurs. The acoustics shift slightly to a more reverberant character. Faint background crowd murmurs are heard in the mix, simulating an indoor event hall. The BGM remains the dominant layer alongside the narration. (4) Mechanical 'ticking' sounds, reminiscent of a film projector, are layered during the vintage footage segments. The narrator's pitch variability increases as he describes specific fashion details. The music continues with a consistent, rhythmic electronic pulse. (5) The narrator concludes with an upbeat and assertive tone. The music swells slightly in volume before fading out abruptly with a final 'ding' sound effect at the very end.
